extra_vocab.en: to follow a rule, law, or request
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇備忘錄裡，comply with the revised evaluation guidelines 表示主管必須遵守修訂後的評核準則。語氣正式，帶有人資對主管的要求與提醒意味，常見於公告、規定與合約。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: comply 是不及物動詞，後面一定要接 with 才能接規定或要求：comply with the rules，不說 comply the rules。

example.en: Our supplier always complies with international safety standards.
example.zh: 我們的供應商一向遵守國際安全標準。

example.en: The factory complied with the new environmental law last year.
example.zh: 這間工廠去年已遵守新的環保法規。

example.en: Complying with the deadline will require extra effort from everyone.
example.zh: 要遵守截止期限，每個人都得多努力。

example.en: All food producers must comply with health regulations.
example.zh: 所有食品生產商都必須遵守衛生法規。

example.en: We are happy to comply with your request for a refund.
example.zh: 我們很樂意依照您的要求辦理退款。

example.en: Companies that fail to comply may face heavy fines.
example.zh: 未遵守規定的公司可能面臨高額罰款。

examples.en: All visitors are required to comply with the building's security rules.
examples.zh: 所有訪客都必須遵守大樓的保全規定。

examples.en: Please comply with the new expense policy starting next month.
examples.zh: 請從下個月起遵守新的費用政策。

examples.en: The auditor checked whether each branch complied with the safety procedures.
examples.zh: 稽核員檢查各分公司是否遵守安全程序。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 complain 是「抱怨、投訴」；comply 是「遵守」。

example.en: Several customers complained about the long delivery time.
example.zh: 有好幾位顧客抱怨運送時間太長。

confusable.diff: compliment 是名詞或動詞，意思是「稱讚」，發音與拼法都像 comply，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The manager paid her a compliment on the clear report.
example.zh: 經理稱讚她的報告寫得清楚。

similar.diff: adhere to 強調嚴格堅持（規則、計畫、標準），語氣比 comply with 更正式、更堅定。

example.en: Staff must adhere to the schedule set by the director.
example.zh: 員工必須嚴格遵守主任訂的時間表。

similar.diff: abide by 常用於接受並遵守規定、決定或協議，後面常接 rules、decision、contract。

example.en: Both companies agreed to abide by the terms of the contract.
example.zh: 兩家公司同意遵守合約條款。

example.en: Drivers must obey the speed limit inside the factory area.
example.zh: 駕駛在廠區內必須遵守速限。

example.en: The new regulation affects all companies with over fifty employees.
example.zh: 新規定影響所有員工超過五十人的公司。

example.en: A college degree is a basic requirement for this position.
example.zh: 大學學歷是這個職位的基本條件。

derived.link: comply 去掉 y 加 -iance，變成名詞，像 rely → reliance
comply 去掉 y 加 -iant，變成形容詞，像 rely → reliant

extra_vocab.en: very interested in doing or getting something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇備忘錄裡，candidates who are eager to move into a supervisory role 指「很想晉升為主管的候選人」。eager 帶有正面、積極的語感，常用來形容員工或應徵者渴望機會。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: eager 後面接 to + 原形動詞，或 for + 名詞：eager to learn、eager for new challenges。不接 V-ing。

example.en: The new team members are eager to start the training program.
example.zh: 新團隊成員迫不及待想開始訓練課程。

example.en: Many young employees are eager for more responsibility.
example.zh: 許多年輕員工渴望承擔更多責任。

example.en: The new assistant is eager to please every client.
example.zh: 新助理急著讓每位客戶都滿意。

examples.en: The candidate seemed eager to join our sales department.
examples.zh: 這位應徵者看起來很想加入我們的業務部。

examples.en: We are eager to hear your feedback on the proposal.
examples.zh: 我們很期待聽到您對提案的意見。

examples.en: Investors are eager to see the results of the new product.
examples.zh: 投資人渴望看到新產品的成果。

similar.diff: keen 也是「熱衷的」，英式英語較常用，常接 on 或 to，語氣比 eager 稍平和。

example.en: She is keen to take on the new project.
example.zh: 她很想接下這個新專案。

similar.diff: enthusiastic 強調表現出來的熱情，常接 about；eager 強調心裡渴望要做某事。

example.en: The staff were enthusiastic about the new office layout.
example.zh: 員工對新的辦公室配置很有熱情。

similar.diff: anxious 後面接 to V 時也可表示「渴望」，但通常是「焦慮、擔心」；eager 只有正面意思。

example.en: Investors are anxious about the falling share price.
example.zh: 投資人對下跌的股價感到焦慮。

example.en: She is an ambitious manager who wants to open new branches.
example.zh: 她是個有抱負的經理，想開設新的分店。

example.en: We are looking for a motivated person to lead the team.
example.zh: 我們在找一位有動力的人來帶領團隊。

example.en: Are you willing to travel abroad twice a year?
example.zh: 你願意每年出國兩次嗎？

derived.link: eager + -ly，變成副詞，像 quick → quickly、happy → happily

extra_vocab.en: not right or suitable for a certain situation
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇備忘錄裡，comments about a candidate's age or personal style are inappropriate 指這類評論不適合出現在評核中，並會被從檔案中移除。語氣是明確的規定與警告，常見於職場守則與公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: inappropriate 後面常接 for + 人／場合，或用句型 It is inappropriate to + V：It is inappropriate to ask about a candidate's age.

example.en: The company has a strict policy against inappropriate behavior at work.
example.zh: 公司對工作場合的不當行為有嚴格的規定。

example.en: Staff should avoid inappropriate language in emails to clients.
example.zh: 員工寫給客戶的電子郵件應避免使用不當用語。

example.en: Casual clothes are inappropriate for a formal business meeting.
example.zh: 休閒服不適合正式的商務會議。

examples.en: Jokes about colleagues are inappropriate in a professional workplace.
examples.zh: 在專業的職場裡，拿同事開玩笑是不恰當的。

examples.en: I apologize if my earlier comment seemed inappropriate.
examples.zh: 如果我先前的意見讓人覺得不恰當，我深感抱歉。

examples.en: It was inappropriate for the agent to raise his voice.
examples.zh: 客服人員提高音量是不恰當的。

similar.diff: unsuitable 指不適合某個用途或對象，如場地、人選；inappropriate 更常指言行不得體。

example.en: This venue is unsuitable for a conference of two hundred people.
example.zh: 這個場地不適合舉辦兩百人的會議。

similar.diff: improper 較正式，常指違反規定或程序的做法，如 improper use。

example.en: Improper use of company equipment may lead to disciplinary action.
example.zh: 不當使用公司設備可能受到懲處。

similar.diff: unacceptable 語氣更強，表示完全無法接受；inappropriate 只是「不恰當」。

example.en: Repeated delays are unacceptable for our largest customer.
example.zh: 對我們最大的客戶而言，一再延誤是無法接受的。

example.en: We are still looking for a suitable candidate for the job.
example.zh: 我們仍在尋找適合這份工作的人選。

example.en: The quality of the samples is acceptable to our buyers.
example.zh: 樣品的品質是我們的買家可以接受的。

example.en: Please keep your tone professional when replying to customers.
example.zh: 回覆顧客時，請保持專業的語氣。

derived.link: 詞幹 appropriate；加上 in-（不）變成相反意思，像 incorrect、inactive
inappropriate + -ly，變成副詞，表示做得不得體
